item.tib: kun tu bzang po nam mkha'i rgyal po'i rgyud las dge spyod yan lag lnga pa
item.coloph: bdag 'dra o rgyan bde chen gling pa'am mi 'gyur tshe dbang gsang sngags grags pa rtsal gyis/ kong yul yongs rdzogs dpal gyi phug nas sa pho rta yi lor spyan drangs shing / slar chu khyi lor bod yig phab pa'i gter dpe bzhin rnam rgyal bkra shis kyis byas pa'i zung ldan dge tshogs ston zla ltar dkar ba'i gzi byin gyis/ 'gro 'di rin gyis nyos pa'i sdug bsngal g.yo long chen po'i mun pa 'jil nas phan bde zab mos 'dzum brlab (rlabs) kun tu g.yo bar gyur cig/
